criteria.criterion: Before planning (named or chosen) vloop run exits 1 unless the brief's status is ready, vloop brief check reports no problem for it and every depends-on entry is consumed, with exactly `vloop: <brief> is <status>, not ready — set status: ready once it passes vloop brief check`, `vloop: <brief> fails vloop brief check (<n> problem(s)) — run vloop brief check <brief>` or `vloop: <brief> depends on <name>, which is <status>, not consumed`; no session runs and nothing is committed.
criteria.evidence: internal/brief/ready.go Plannable returns the three messages verbatim and is called in internal/driver/plan.go before planning; TestRunRefusesDraftBriefs, TestRunRefusesUncheckedBrief and TestRunRefusesUnconsumedDependency assert the exact line, zero sessions, no commit and still on main

criteria.criterion: With no argument the brief chosen is the newest ready one; with none, exactly `vloop: no ready brief in docs/briefs/ — name one, or set status: ready on a checked brief`, exit 1.
criteria.evidence: brief.Newest walks entries from the end for status ready; plan.go halts with the exact message; TestRunPlansNewestReadyBrief (newer draft beside a ready brief) and TestRunRefusesDraftBriefs

criteria.criterion: The check runs vloop brief check's own code, not a second copy of it; resuming a plan that already exists does not re-check its brief.

criteria.criterion: Resuming also requires a clean tree, except for changes under .vloop/state/ (the operator's vloop task verify|reset|note|drop|set), which the next iteration commits.
criteria.evidence: requireCleanTree(root, resuming) skips .vloop/state/ only when resuming and is called on both paths; TestRunResumeAllowsStateEdits refuses with stray.txt and then resumes to done after a task note
